# Output

Plots, shapes, levels and fills drawn on the chart, plus alerts and the log.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`plot()`](#plot) | Draws a series on the chart. |
| [`plotShape()`](#plotshape) | Draws a marker on every bar where `cond` is 1. |
| [`plotCandle()`](#plotcandle) | Draws candles (or OHLC bars) from four series, e.g. |
| [`plotVolumeProfile()`](#plotvolumeprofile) | A volume profile built by the chart from its own candles: over the visible bars (`range: "visible"`, drawn at the right edge) or per session (`range: "session"`, one histogram per UTC day or week). |
| [`hline()`](#hline) | Draws a horizontal line at a fixed level, e.g. |
| [`fill()`](#fill) | Shades the area between two series, or a series and a level, or two levels (e.g. |
| [`bgcolor()`](#bgcolor) | Tints the background of every bar where `cond` is 1. |
| [`barcolor()`](#barcolor) | Recolours the chart's candles on every bar where `cond` is 1 (TradingView barcolor). |
| [`alert()`](#alert) | Records an alert with a name and a message in the run's journal. |
| [`log()`](#log) | Writes a line to the run's journal; objects are written as JSON. |

### plot() {#plot}

```ts
plot(series: Series, options?: PlotOptions): void
```

Draws a series on the chart. Call it at the top level, once per line.

Types: [Series](./series#series), [PlotOptions](#plotoptions)

### plotShape() {#plotshape}

```ts
plotShape(cond: BoolSeries | boolean, options?: ShapeOptions): void
```

Draws a marker on every bar where `cond` is 1. Pass a series (e.g. `ta.crossover(...)`); a plain boolean draws nothing.

Types: [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries), [ShapeOptions](#shapeoptions)

### plotCandle() {#plotcandle}

```ts
plotCandle(open: Series, high: Series, low: Series, close: Series, options?: { title?: string; colorUp?: string; colorDown?: string; wickColor?: string; style?: "candle" | "bar"; pane?: number; display?: "all" | "pane" | "legend" | "none"; }): void
```

Draws candles (or OHLC bars) from four series, e.g. Heikin Ashi in its own pane or over the price.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### plotVolumeProfile() {#plotvolumeprofile}

```ts
plotVolumeProfile(options?: { title?: string; range?: "visible" | "session"; session?: "day" | "week"; rows?: number; valueArea?: number; widthPercent?: number; placement?: "right" | "left"; upColor?: string; downColor?: string; vaUpColor?: string; vaDownColor?: string; pocColor?: string; showPoc?: boolean; }): void
```

A volume profile built by the chart from its own candles: over the visible bars (`range: "visible"`, drawn at the right edge) or per session (`range: "session"`, one histogram per UTC day or week). Rows split each bar's volume evenly across its high-low range, coloured by the bar's direction; the value area holds `valueArea` percent of the volume around the point of control (POC).

### hline() {#hline}

```ts
hline(value: number, options?: { title?: string; color?: string; style?: "solid" | "dashed" | "dotted"; width?: number; pane?: number }): void
```

Draws a horizontal line at a fixed level, e.g. 70 and 30 on an RSI pane.

### fill() {#fill}

```ts
fill(a: Series | number, b: Series | number, options?: { color?: string; colorDown?: string; title?: string; offset?: number }): void
```

Shades the area between two series, or a series and a level, or two levels (e.g. RSI 30..70). With `colorDown` the shading switches colour where `a` falls below `b` (an Ichimoku cloud); `offset` shifts it like `plot`'s.

Types: [Series](./series#series)

### bgcolor() {#bgcolor}

```ts
bgcolor(cond: BoolSeries | boolean, options?: { color?: string }): void
```

Tints the background of every bar where `cond` is 1. Pass a series; a plain boolean draws nothing.

Types: [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### barcolor() {#barcolor}

```ts
barcolor(cond: BoolSeries, options: { color: string }): void
```

Recolours the chart's candles on every bar where `cond` is 1 (TradingView barcolor). Later calls win on the same bar.

Types: [BoolSeries](./series#boolseries)

### alert() {#alert}

```ts
alert(name: string, message: string): void
```

Records an alert with a name and a message in the run's journal. Alerts and log lines together are capped at 2,000 per run.

### log() {#log}

```ts
log(...args: unknown[]): void
```

Writes a line to the run's journal; objects are written as JSON. Log lines and alerts together are capped at 2,000 per run.

## Types

### PlotOptions {#plotoptions}

Options of `plot()`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title?` | `string` | legend label (default "plot N") |
| `color?` | `string` | CSS colour (default grey) |
| `width?` | `number` | line width in pixels (default 1) |
| `style?` | `"line" \| "step" \| "area" \| "histogram" \| "columns" \| "circles" \| "cross" \| "baseline"` | line, step (stepline), area, histogram (from 0), columns (wide histogram), circles, cross, baseline |
| `lineStyle?` | `"solid" \| "dashed" \| "dotted"` |  |
| `colorUp?` | `string` | histogram/columns: colour of values &gt;= 0 / &lt; 0 (e.g. the MACD histogram); baseline: above/below `baseValue` |
| `colorDown?` | `string` |  |
| `colorBy?` | `"sign" \| "candle"` | what picks colorUp/colorDown: the value's sign (default) or the bar's direction (close &gt;= open), as volume does |
| `baseValue?` | `number` | the level a baseline plot is coloured above and below |
| `display?` | `"all" \| "pane" \| "legend" \| "none"` | "all" (default), "pane" (no legend value), "legend" (legend value only, not drawn), "none" |
| `pane?` | `number` | 0 = price pane (overlay), 1.. = separate panes. In an `indicator({ overlay: false })` every plot goes to the indicator's own pane on the chart. |
| `offset?` | `number` | Shifts the plot by whole bars: positive draws it into the future (e.g. Ichimoku's leading spans), negative into the past. |
| `palette?` | `readonly string[]` | Per-bar colours: `colorIndex` picks `palette[colorIndex]` on each bar (NaN or out of range = `color`). |
| `colorIndex?` | [`Series`](./series#series) | The series of palette indexes, e.g. `ta.calc([ao, ta.change(ao)], (v, d) => (d >= 0 ? 0 : 1))`. |

### ShapeOptions {#shapeoptions}

Options of `plotShape()`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shape?` | `"triangleUp" \| "triangleDown" \| "circle" \| "square" \| "arrowUp" \| "arrowDown" \| "label"` | default "circle" |
| `location?` | `"aboveBar" \| "belowBar" \| "absolute"` | default "belowBar" |
| `color?` | `string` |  |
| `text?` | `string` |  |
| `size?` | `"tiny" \| "small" \| "normal" \| "large"` |  |
| `offset?` | `number` | Draws the marker this many bars back (0 or negative), e.g. -2 to mark a pivot found two bars late. |
